name: Influzer.ai
description: Influzer.ai exposes its MCP and WebMCP directories as browser-native WebMCP tools so agents can search sites, inspect schemas, and navigate without scraping the UI.

tools.name: get_influzer_overview
tools.description: Return a short overview of Influzer.ai: what it offers (MCP directory, WebMCP directory, insights) and key URLs agents should use.

tools.name: get_webmcp_directory_stats
tools.description: Return live counts for the Influzer WebMCP Directory: sites, tools, live vs demo, categories, and last refresh time.

tools.name: search_webmcp_sites
tools.description: Search websites in the Influzer WebMCP Directory by keyword, category, site type, or verification status. Returns matching hosts with tool counts.

q.description: Free-text query matching host, name, description, or category.

type.description: Filter by site type. Defaults to all.

verified.description: Filter by verification status. Defaults to any.

limit.description: Max results to return (1–25). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_webmcp_site
tools.description: Fetch one WebMCP-enabled website by host (e.g. persona-chat.dev), including description, tool list, and schemas when available.

include_schemas.description: When true, include full input schemas for each tool. Defaults to false for a shorter payload.

tools.name: search_webmcp_tools
tools.description: Search WebMCP tools across all catalogued websites by tool name, description, or kind (answer / act / transact).

q.description: Free-text query matching tool name or description.

kind.description: Filter by tool kind. Defaults to any.

host.description: Optional host to limit tools to one site.

tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search Influzer's MCP server directory (backend MCP integrations, not WebMCP). Returns matching servers with categories and tool names.

q.description: Free-text query matching server name, slug, description, or category.

scope.description: Search Top 100 (default) or the full catalog.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Get full details for one MCP server by slug: description, transport, install command, remote endpoint, indexed tools, and Influzer page URL.

slug.description: Server slug from the Influzer directory (e.g. playwright, github).

tools.name: get_current_mcp_server
tools.description: Return the MCP server profile for the current /mcp/{slug} detail page when the user is viewing one. Falls back to slug lookup when opened elsewhere.

slug.description: Optional slug override when not on a server detail page.

tools.name: copy_mcp_connection
tools.description: Copy the install command or remote MCP endpoint for a server to the clipboard. Prefer when the user asks to install or connect on the current detail page.

slug.description: Optional slug when not on the matching /mcp/{slug} page.

tools.name: list_best_mcp_clients
tools.description: List Influzer client-intent guides (/mcp/best) — currently Claude, with more clients as they ship. Returns titles, featured counts, and URLs.

tools.name: get_best_mcp_client
tools.description: Get a client-intent guide by slug (e.g. claude): Claude.ai vs Desktop vs Code surfaces, starter stacks with server links, checklist, and FAQs.

slug.description: Client slug (e.g. claude). Aliases like claude-desktop also resolve.

tools.name: get_current_best_mcp_client
tools.description: Return the client-intent guide for the current /mcp/best/{slug} page (e.g. Best MCP for Claude). Falls back to slug lookup when opened elsewhere.

slug.description: Optional client slug override when not on a best-client page.

tools.name: list_latest_insights
tools.description: List the latest Influzer.ai insights / articles (titles, URLs, summaries) for agent briefings.

tools.name: navigate_influzer
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to a first-party Influzer.ai path (e.g. /webmcp, /mcp, /webmcp/demo, /insights). Use after the user confirms they want to move.

path.description: Site path starting with /. Only same-origin Influzer paths are allowed.
